answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be. Consider a opal as the anchor of the cost.
